 Krungthai Card expands Shopee partnership to target premium e-commerce spending in Thailand
 by Jerica Baracena 
 - 
 November 3, 2026
 Our What’s NEXT in Marketing 2026 Conference Series returns to the Philippines , Singapore , Hong Kong , Indonesia , Malaysia —and for the first time in Thailand ! Brace yourself for bold ideas driving the next marketing wave. Click here to learn more!
 Thailand – Krungthai Card (KTC) is expanding its partnership with Shopee Thailand to target premium e-commerce spending, with cardmember offers focused on selected premium products and technology purchases.
 The joint venture forms part of KTC’s data-driven marketing strategy, which aims to develop more targeted benefits based on customer spending behaviour and lifestyle preferences. The company is looking to address demand for premium and high-value products amid more cautious consumer spending.
 Under the collaboration, KTC credit card and KTC PROUD cash card members will have the chance to get discounts on selected products listed under Shopee Premium. It applies to participating brands, including 111SKIN, Dyson, Elemis, L’Occitane and THREE, from 1 October to 31 December 2026.
 The partnership also extends to selected Apple products available through official Apple stores and authorised resellers on Shopee. From 1 October to 31 December 2026, eligible KTC credit card and KTC PROUD cash card purchases are subject to discounts, based on specified spending conditions.
 Separately, KTC UNIONPAY cardmembers will also be eligible for discounts, with the offer running until 31 January 2027 and applies to regular shopping periods and Double Date campaigns.
 Nattasit Soontranu, Head of Credit Card Marketing Division at Krungthai Card Public Company Limited (KTC), said, “Consumers may be more selective with spending amid current economic conditions, but they remain willing to invest in products they trust, particularly premium brands and technology products that deliver long-term value.
 Soontranu continued: “The continued growth of purchases through Shopee Premium and leading Apple products highlights the importance of both product quality and platform credibility in purchasing decisions.
 “Through this partnership with Shopee, KTC is reinforcing its commitment to delivering benefits that align with today’s digital lifestyle. Consumers increasingly expect quality, convenience and value at the same time.”
 “By leveraging customer insights and collaborating with leading partners, we aim to create more relevant privileges while expanding spending opportunities across fast-growing e-commerce categories,” Soontranu concluded. 
 The partnership reflects KTC’s efforts to align its cardmember benefits with purchasing patterns in premium online retail, including consumers’ focus on product quality and trusted digital shopping channels.
